title: Remove all user-uploaded photos and videos from backend and UI

requirements.summary: Add delete button to each media post card in the feed and profile views that allows users to remove their uploaded photos and videos
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button appears on PostCard components for media posts
Button is only visible to the post owner or admins
Clicking delete button triggers confirmation dialog
Button uses appropriate icon (trash/delete)
Button is styled consistently with existing UI

file_operations.description: Add conditional delete button (Trash2 icon from lucide-react) to PostCard component that appears only when the current user is the post author or an admin. The button should be positioned in the post header area alongside other post actions. Use the authorization component's pattern to check if the current user's principal matches the post.author principal or if isCallerAdmin returns true. Wire the delete button to trigger the confirmation dialog from REQ-3.

requirements.summary: Implement confirmation dialog before deleting media to prevent accidental deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Dialog shows clear warning message about permanent deletion
Dialog has 'Cancel' and 'Delete' buttons
Delete button is styled with destructive/danger variant
Dialog prevents action until user explicitly confirms
Dialog closes after action completes

file_operations.description: Create a confirmation dialog component using shadcn/ui AlertDialog. The dialog should display a warning message about permanent deletion of the media post, with 'Cancel' and 'Delete' buttons. The Delete button should use the destructive variant for visual emphasis. Accept postId as a prop and expose open/onOpenChange props for state management. When confirmed, call the delete mutation hook from REQ-5 and close the dialog after the operation completes. Display loading state on the Delete button during mutation.
Import and integrate DeletePostDialog component. Add state to manage dialog open/closed state. Wire the delete button click handler to open the dialog. Pass the post.id to the dialog component.

requirements.summary: Remove deleted media posts from UI immediately after successful deletion without requiring page refresh
acceptanceCriteria: Deleted post disappears from feed immediately
Deleted post disappears from profile page immediately
React Query cache is invalidated for affected queries
Success toast notification appears after deletion
No orphaned UI elements remain after deletion

file_operations.description: After successful deletion mutation, invalidate React Query caches for 'posts' and 'userPosts' query keys to trigger refetch on FeedPage and ProfilePage. Display a success toast notification using shadcn/ui toast component with message 'Post deleted successfully'. Handle error states with error toast notifications.

requirements.summary: Add delete mutation hook in useQueries.ts that calls the backend deletion method and handles loading/error states
acceptanceCriteria: Mutation hook follows existing patterns in useQueries.ts
Hook handles loading state during deletion
Hook handles and displays error messages
Hook invalidates relevant queries on success
Hook returns mutation status for UI feedback

file_operations.description: Add useDeletePost mutation hook following the existing mutation patterns in the file. The hook should accept postId as a parameter, call actor.deletePost(postId), handle loading/error states, and return mutation status. On successful deletion, invalidate the 'posts' query key and any user-specific post queries. Use useMutation from @tanstack/react-query and follow the error handling pattern used in other mutations (e.g., useCreatePost). The backend method deletePost already exists in the backend interface.
